dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical 2D narrowing of the silhouette from the mid-body region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are primarily convex and smooth, with a subtle asymmetrical protrusion on the right lateral edge at the mid-body.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high median pixel intensity with a consistent light-blue/cool-toned reflectance across the dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One dark circular point feature at the anterior-most apex and one faint, thin transverse linear mark across the mid-dorsal plane.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A prominent raised longitudinal ridge along the central dorsal axis, casting a subtle shadow along its left margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint, thin linear mark oriented transversely across the central dorsal region, consistent with a healed surface scrape.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible anterior blowhole at the top-most point of the dorsal plane.
